briefdescription.para: Computes the length of a null-terminated string safely.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_strlen.
The number of characters preceding the terminating null byte, or 0 if str is MPTAR_NULL.

briefdescription.para: Computes the length of a string up to a maximum limit safely.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_strnlen.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum number of bytes to inspect.

simplesect.para: The number of characters preceding the terminating null byte or max_limit, whichever comes first, or 0 if str is MPTAR_NULL.

briefdescription.para: Copies a string with a fixed maximum buffer size, padding remaining space with null bytes.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_strncpy.

parameterdescription.para: Maximum number of bytes to copy into dst.

simplesect.para: Pointer to the destination buffer dst.

briefdescription.para: Copies a block of memory from source to destination.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_memcpy.

briefdescription.para: Fills a block of memory with a specific byte value.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_memset.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the memory block to fill.

simplesect.para: This function can be overridden by defining mptar_memcmp.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the first memory block.
Pointer to the second memory block.

simplesect.para: 0 if the blocks match, a negative value if s1 is less than s2, or a positive value if s1 is greater than s2.

briefdescription.para: Minimal PAX and USTAR TAR archive library.
